overview_description.description:
Socket is a new security company that can protect your most critical apps from supply chain attacks. We are taking an entirely new approach to one of the hardest problems in security in a stagnant part of the industry that has historically been obsessed with just reporting on known vulnerabilities.

Socket is built by a team of open source maintainers with over 1 billion monthly downloads. Everyone on the Socket team is an open source maintainer. We are all driven to defend the open source ecosystem from supply chain attacks and make it safe for everyone.

Socket is unique because, unlike other tools, it detects and blocks supply chain attacks before they strike, mitigating the worst consequences.

about_short_description.short_description: Socket is a developer-first security platform that protects your most critical apps from software supply chain attacks.

product.name: Socket for GitHub
product.description: A GitHub App that scans dependency changes in pull requests, identifies software supply chain risks, and applies configurable security policies before code is merged.

product.name: Socket Firewall
product.description: An install-time dependency security control that intercepts package requests, evaluates risk, and allows, warns, or blocks packages on developer machines, in CI, and in production builds.

product.name: Socket Reachability
product.description: A static analysis capability that identifies whether vulnerable dependency code can be reached by an application, reducing irrelevant CVE alerts and prioritizing exploitable risks.

product.name: Socket CLI
product.description: A command-line tool for scanning projects, checking packages, enforcing security and license policies, generating SBOMs, reviewing threat intelligence, fixing CVEs, and protecting dependency installs.

product.name: Socket Certified Patches
product.description: A dependency remediation service that applies human-reviewed, AI-validated patches to remove exploitable CVEs without requiring dependency version upgrades.

product.name: Socket Dependency Search
product.description: An organizational dependency search tool that provides security, quality, maintenance, vulnerability, license, and supply chain insights for open-source packages and repositories.
